hints: At the end of any given day you are in one of a small number of situations. What are they?
Holding an item, having just sold today, or free to buy. Three states, and the cooldown is exactly what separates the last two.
Write the best profit achievable in each state at the end of each day, in terms of the three values from the day before.
Holding comes from holding, or from being free and buying today. Just-sold comes only from holding and selling today. Free comes from being free, or from having sold *yesterday*.
